evals.prompt: Act as a fresh agent. Scaffold and render a deterministic eight-second desktop Highlight that creates one task. Show me the scenario shape, cheap storyboard review, dry-run, external stage review, and separate promotion command. I do not want custom capture, camera, or encoder scripts.
evals.expected_output: A schema-v1 scenario flow using stable semantic selectors, deterministic seed/setup, exact desktop profile, no zoom by default, storyboard before capture, one run command through accepted QA and content-addressed staging, then a separate collision-refusing promotion dry-run and promotion.
expectations: Uses node scripts/highlights.mjs scaffold, validate, storyboard, run, and promote
Uses testId or role plus exact accessible name and no arbitrary JavaScript or shell
States that default camera is centered 1x with no zoom by default
Keeps raw masters and QA outside the repository
Requires automatic media, containment, motion, sensitive-data, contact-sheet, browser, hash, and byte QA
Promotes only after accepted review and refuses an existing immutable revision

evals.prompt: Author native-phone and desktop Highlight scenarios for the same board story. Zoom should stay calm, cursor motion must remain smooth, and mobile must not be a crop.
evals.expected_output: Two native scenario routes with exact CSS/DPR/source profiles, deterministic shared seed intent, independent semantic actions, identity camera unless explicit focus is useful, bounded 1.5x desktop and 1.18x mobile motion, containment, and settled bookends.
expectations: Uses 1920x1200 DPR2 to 3840x2400 desktop source and 1920x1200 delivery at 25 fps
Uses 430x932 DPR3 native-mobile context and 1290x2796 source/delivery at 25 fps
Rejects hover and middle/right click on native mobile and uses trusted touch tap/drag
Separates cursor control from focus/zoom/hold/return camera directives
Requires camera motion, safe-margin, target-glyph, cursor, and opening/ending settle QA

evals.prompt: Migrate an accepted old pilot that has a hand-written Playwright script, camera JSON, encoder script, contact sheet, and manual asset copy. Only poster and framing need to change.
evals.expected_output: A migration map from bespoke artifacts to scenario actions, registered seed/setup, shared landing adapter, automatic QA, external stage, and immutable promotion; it reuses the clean raw when provenance/source digest and semantic evidence pass instead of recapturing solely for migration.
expectations: Does not recapture merely for migration
Reuses clean raw for framing/poster/pacing only when source digest and QA permit
Maps hand-authored camera and encoder code to scripts/product-loop-highlight.mjs
Preserves prior accepted revision and promotes a new immutable revision without overwrite
